START.name: Order Received
START.description: HTTP POST /orders request arrives at OrderController.

VALIDATE_ORDER.name: Validate Order
VALIDATE_ORDER.description: Validates items, stock, and customer data.

DECIDE_PAYMENT_METHOD.name: Payment Method?
DECIDE_PAYMENT_METHOD.description: Decides between upfront (synchronous call to the gateway) and installments (async approval flow).

CHARGE_PAYMENT_GATEWAY.name: Await Payment Gateway Confirmation
CHARGE_PAYMENT_GATEWAY.description: Sends the charge to the external gateway and waits for an asynchronous confirmation callback.

extensionProperties.kikwi:documentation:
More than one system is involved in this round trip, so the interaction is documented as a sequence diagram instead of prose:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant OS as OrderService
    participant PG as Payment Gateway
    participant WH as PaymentGatewayCallbackController
    OS->>PG: POST /charges (orderId, amount)
    PG-->>OS: 202 Accepted (charge queued)
    Note over OS: Flow waits here (EXTERNAL_TASK)
    PG->>WH: webhook onPaymentConfirmed(orderId)
    WH->>OS: resumes flow -> ORDER_CONFIRMED
```

PAYMENT_DECLINED_CATCH.name: Payment Declined (Webhook)
PAYMENT_DECLINED_CATCH.description: Cancels the wait when the gateway sends a decline webhook, correlated by order id. Has no box of its own in the diagram — the editor draws this as a row inside the 'Await Payment Gateway Confirmation' card (see beautify-kikwi-diagram); the layout.x/y below only exists because the field is required by the schema, not because it occupies its own visual space.
